properties.name: title
properties.description: 标题（设置为 null 时，不显示标题）

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description: 标题的提示框

properties.name: onBack
properties.description: 返回操作

properties.name: operationList
properties.description: 标题右侧功能区域，该参数渲染为固定样式

properties.name: customOperation
properties.description: 标题右侧功能区域，该参数自定义渲染样式

properties.name: hideHeader
properties.description: 隐藏 header

properties.name: layout
properties.description: 全屏模式

properties.name: renderContent
properties.type: ((content: { header: React.ReactNode; body: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode) | false
properties.description: 自定义渲染 normal 布局下的右侧内容

properties.name: content
properties.description: 内容组件

properties.name: leftContent
properties.description: 左侧content占位，如果有该参数，渲染为两列布局，否则渲染为整页布局

properties.name: footer
properties.description: 底部组件(不传入leftContent时支持配置footer)

properties.name: footerBtnPosition
properties.description: 底部按钮位置

properties.name: footerContent
properties.description: 底部按钮在右侧时，左侧传入的组件

properties.name: onCancel
properties.description: 取消事件

properties.name: cancelText
properties.description: 取消文字

properties.name: cancelButtonProps
properties.description: 取消按钮arcoProps

properties.name: onSubmit
properties.description: 确认事件

properties.name: submitText
properties.description: 确认文字

properties.name: submitButtonProps
properties.description: 确认按钮arcoProps

properties.name: className
properties.description: 节点类型

properties.name: prefixCls
properties.description: 内置的 arco 组件的前缀

properties.name: autoWidthForFullPage
properties.description: 全屏模式下是否自动宽度撑满，默认不撑满、宽度1260

properties.name: autoHeightWithViewPort
properties.description: 是否按当前视图自动高度撑满，默认是height：100% (主要是兼容初版存量逻辑)

properties.name: configForNormalLayout
properties.type: {/*** @zh layout 为 normal 时，content 的style*/contentStyle?: CSSProperties;/*** @zh layout 为 normal 时，header 的style*/headerStyle?: CSSProperties;}
properties.description: layout 为 normal 时的专属配置

properties.name: customTopContent
properties.description: 页面顶部的自定义内容

properties.name: inputMode
properties.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

properties.name: is
properties.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element
